findings.current: the man who had barely escaped death at the cost of that arm
findings.defect: “At the cost of that arm” implies the man lost the arm to survive. The Korean says someone who barely escaped death was falling alongside the severed arm; it does not say that the arm belonged to him or that losing it was the price of his survival.
findings.rationale: The preceding description identifies the severed arm as the Blood Lord’s. The Korean’s wording in line 31 does not assign that arm to the person who is falling.
findings.replacement: someone who had barely escaped death at its very edge, collapsing alongside the severed arm

summary: The translation is faithful overall, with one added implication about whose arm was lost.
